summary: Trace opens long chats much faster and keeps the panel responsive under heavy activity. Nothing you see changes; only the work behind it is lighter.
Read nested event fields and multiline text beside exact JSON. Investigate a failed event for a short AI explanation, with remembered model and reasoning settings.
A small red exclamation mark highlights recorded failures, including failures inside collapsed actions. Parent markers point to contained evidence without judging the whole task.
Live event bursts now appear in a short progression with smoother following. Reduced motion and paused reading keep updates immediate.
Install Trace from GitHub with clear app and CLI steps, plus update, removal and local-development guidance.
Inspect observed operation time and host-reported token receipts, with overlap, missing evidence and accounting limits made explicit.
Mark surprising events and revisit their original evidence from a compact list. Marks stay in memory, with clear limits and unavailable evidence states.
Open a factual recap of a selected request interval or retained range. Counts stay fixed while you inspect their original evidence, with missing results and history limits stated.
Prepare a prompt with an optional developer checklist and a temporary draft. Copy an outline without sending it to the chat; closing discards the draft.
Explore plausible next actions for supported observations, with conditions and evidence links. These optional teaching scenarios stay separate from recorded activity.
Explore three synthetic examples of repository exploration, a bug fix and recovery after failure. Step through each demonstration while keeping live activity separate.
Replay a retained activity snapshot with step and playback controls while live capture continues. Return to current activity with an explicit Follow choice.
Practice predicting the next observed action in optional live and replay exercises. Feedback links to recorded evidence and leaves missing or ambiguous outcomes unknown.
Understand what supported read, edit and process results establish, with a route to separately observed validation. Tool status, process exit and overall task correctness remain distinct.

Compare two selected retained tool calls with bounded literal argument differences and original evidence links. Protected omissions, incomplete arguments, incompatible calls and expired records remain explicit.

Inspect exact repeated operations and recurring recorded failures in an optional retained-window overview. Counts link to original evidence and keep tool results, process exits and missing outcomes separate.
Inspect retained activity with missing decisions or outcomes, keeping connection status and unknown current activity separate.
Permission details now explain recorded approval scope and keep the approver, tool outcome and process exit separate.
Inspect a retained overview of recognized validation commands, keeping process outcomes, repeated attempts and unknown test counts distinct.
Compare a reported check result with retained evidence through explicit user links, keeping candidates and process outcomes distinct.
Inspect failed operations beside clearly labeled related-attempt suggestions. Original outcomes, arguments and evidence remain separate.
Inspect recorded subagent handoffs, child activity and returned results. Missing links and separate-context limits stay explicit.
Inspect recorded compaction summaries and comparable context-token estimates. Missing boundaries, shortened evidence and unknown memory effects remain explicit.
Compare instruction guidance, configured hooks and permission controls, with examples from retained events. Recorded decisions stay separate from general explanations and task correctness.
Explore host-reported instruction sources and their declared scope alongside recorded skill loads. Current source text stays separate from historical load evidence.
See why retained counts or evidence may be incomplete, including when the event feed disconnects. Changing views now preserves the actual connection status.
See requested ranges, excerpts and explicitly shortened output separately from the evidence limits in Trace. Unknown coverage remains clear.
Inspect recorded reads, searches and web retrieval attempts in a bounded ledger. Requested scope, returned results and missing evidence stay distinct.
Learn core AI-agent terms through a contextual glossary with retained event examples. Definitions and deeper explanations share one vocabulary.
Statistics can compare a current capability snapshot with retained tool and skill use. Scope, freshness and unknown availability stay explicit.
Skill events now preview the recorded instructions and trigger, with exact retained text available. Missing or shortened content stays explicit, and loading is distinguished from execution.
Hook groups now explain timing and recorded outcomes, with invocation counts and original evidence. Missing boundaries and unknown hook types remain explicit.
Tool cards now label recognized requested operations, with clear limits for shell commands and unknown tools. Categories stay separate from recorded outcomes.
Tool cards now show recorded MCP provenance and provider details. Missing or unverified origins stay unknown.
Tool cards now show linked recorded requests, permission decisions, invocation starts and results. Missing or ambiguous stages remain unknown.
Event details now separate what happened, what the recorded result means and what remains unknown. General explanations and original evidence stay available.
Jump to the latest retained failure, permission request, skill load or tool result. Navigation reveals the original event and pauses Follow live.
Compare recorded main-chat and subagent activity in lanes, with honest timing limits and links to supported source evidence.
Focus the timeline on tools, automation or problems while keeping retained totals and hidden activity clear. Reset the filter to restore the full view.
Model turns can show recorded activity with a direct link to its evidence. Uncertain or incomplete intervals keep neutral headings.
Browse retained activity in request chapters, with recorded prompt previews and explicit steering, queued-input and uncertain-boundary labels.
Follow each tool call from its recorded start to its result in one expandable card, with honest partial states, timing and access to chronological events.
Identify assistant, tool, automation and user activity with clear actor labels, keeping source identity separate and explaining the roles in the panel.

Show plain-language titles for recognized view and search requests while keeping original evidence and result status available. Release checks can now record an explicitly authorized deferral of manual UI review.
Move Statistics into a quiet, always-visible bottom bar with a compact turn and tool count. Open it as an upward overlay drawer while keeping the timeline in place.
Add a collapsible activity overview with turn, hook, tool and skill counts. Show model turns as headings with indented activity and compact closing markers, keeping incomplete boundaries explicit.
Scrolling away from the bottom now turns off Follow live so you can look around without being pulled back. Check Follow live again to jump to the bottom and resume following.
Rename the product to Trace across the canvas, tab, logs and documentation. Follow live now stays at the bottom of the whole plugin, including the footer, as activity and layout change.
Open Versions, Settings and Logs in centered overlay dialogs with a dimmed backdrop. Close or press Escape to return to the footer without expanding content below the timeline.
Add a footer with expandable release notes, refresh, text-size settings and GitHub feedback. View, copy or export private-content-free plugin diagnostics to help troubleshoot problems.

Introduce a compact connected-path SVG logo for plugin metadata, panel header and favicon. Group consecutive hook events into expandable sections, retaining individual evidence, event order and agent boundaries.

Redesign Trace as a connected vertical flow with compact color-coded nodes, message previews, recorded model and tool names, and expandable evidence. Move technical metadata into details and improve narrow-pane, keyboard, light and dark presentations.

Add a live timeline of current-chat activity with turn markers, expandable recorded evidence and skill-trigger explanations. Load available history, bound in-memory retention, and preserve expanded steps during updates. No model calls or saved transcripts.

Restore automatic versioning and publication to main, mandatory independent review, verification receipts, manual UI acceptance evidence, and measured usage accounting. Document the expanded transfer from Copilot Explore.
Initial Trace canvas shell with local installation, packaging, isolated runtime verification, and reusable Copilot development guidance adapted from Copilot Explore.
